+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8380'
+title: 'files.grep finds the agent''s own transcripts under .acp-agent/'
+---
+## Blocker
+
+The requested fix conflicts with a documented contract. A person must decide before work starts.
+
+- The request: give `.acp-agent/` its own `.gitignore`, as `.code-context/` has, so that `files.grep` does not search it.
+- The contract: `plan.md:515-517`, "### 4.3 Transcripts are committed — the transcript is the source" and "**We commit transcripts. We do not ignore them.**" `SessionIndex.swift:129-136` writes a `.gitattributes` (`** linguist-generated=true`, `sessions.jsonl merge=union`) for committed transcripts. `.acp-agent/` also holds the project config layer (`Sources/acp-agent/AgentComposition.swift:26-30`), which a user commits.
+
+A `*` ignore rule in `.acp-agent/` or in `.acp-agent/transcripts/` stops the commit of transcripts and of the project config. So the two rules cannot both be correct.
+
+Possible decisions for the person (not chosen here): change plan.md §4.3; or keep §4.3 and make the `files` tools (in the sibling repo FoundationModelsMultitool) skip the agent's own transcript directory; or make the bench write transcripts outside the workspace (`transcripts.location: home` or an absolute path in `bench/code-context.config.yaml`).
+
+## Why
+
+Found in the SWE-bench runs. `files.grep` in the agent workspace matches the agent's own transcripts (`.acp-agent/transcripts/<session>/transcript.jsonl`). The model then reads its own earlier output as a search result. `.claude/skills/swebench/scripts/scan.py:741` counts these self-matches.
+
+## Where the code is
+
+- The transcript root: `Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Transcripts/TranscriptLocation.swift:42-58` (`project` gives `<cwd>/.<name>/transcripts/`).
+- The root is made by `Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Transcripts/SessionIndex.swift:250-257` (`materializeRoot()`, writes `.gitattributes` only).
+- The dotfolder name: `Sources/acp-agent/AgentComposition.swift:30` (`dotfolderName = "acp-agent"`).
+- How `.code-context/` gets its ignore rule: sibling repo FoundationModelsCodeContext, `Sources/FoundationModelsCodeContext/Index/Store.swift:139-146` (`bootstrapIndexDirectory`, writes `*\n`).
+- A second example: sibling repo FoundationModelsMultitool, `Sources/FoundationModelsMultitool/Capabilities/Shell/ShellState.swift:651-662` and `:716-718` (`.shell/.gitignore` that ignores all files except itself, written only when absent).
+- `files.grep` uses the git-aware `FileWalker` (FoundationModelsMultitool `Capabilities/Files/Grep.swift:211`, `GrepEngine.swift:110`), so an ignore rule removes the directory from the search.
+
+## What to do
+
+After the person decides: apply the decision, and add a test that proves `files.grep` in a workspace with a recorded session gives no line from the agent's own transcripts.
+
+## Acceptance
+
+- The decision is recorded in this task and, if it changes the contract, in plan.md.
+- A bench run gives zero "files.grep results with .acp-agent/transcripts lines" in `scan.py`.
+- `swift build` has no warnings, and `swift test` passes.
+
+#stuck #tools #bench
\ No newline at end of file
